summary: The Gambia admits ECOWAS citizens without a visa, as well as citizens of the countries on its visa-exemption list, among them the UK, Canada, Australia, Germany, Italy, Spain, the Netherlands and Sweden — the UK government says British visitors are stamped in for 28 days, which can be extended twice by 28 days — while citizens of the countries on its entry-clearance-only lists, such as Kenya, Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, Jamaica, Barbados and Fiji, need no visa but an approved entry clearance, and US, French and various other passport holders need a visa.

faq.question: Do I need a visa for The Gambia?
faq.answer: Citizens of ECOWAS states enter visa-free, as do citizens of the countries on the Immigration Department's visa-exemption list — including the UK, Germany, Italy, Spain, the Netherlands, Sweden, Finland, Canada and Australia — and Ireland says Irish citizens can enter without a visa; the UK government says British visitors are stamped in for 28 days, and Ireland says Irish citizens may stay up to 90 days. Citizens of the countries on the department's entry-clearance-only lists, such as Kenya, Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand, Jamaica, Barbados and Fiji, need no visa but an approved entry clearance, whose original their host in The Gambia presents on or before arrival. US, French, Portuguese and various other passport holders need a visa, which the Immigration Department says is issued by Gambian embassies, missions and consulates abroad and by immigration officers at the gazetted entry points.

faq.question: Do US citizens need a visa for The Gambia?
faq.answer: Yes. The Immigration Department lists the United States among the countries whose citizens need only a visa (no entry clearance). It says visas are issued by Gambian embassies, missions and consulates abroad and by immigration officers at the gazetted entry points.

faq.question: How long can I stay in The Gambia?
faq.answer: The UK government says British visitors are stamped in for 28 days on arrival and can get 2 extensions of 28 days from the Immigration Office in Banjul or the tourist police stations in the Tourism Development Area, and Ireland says Irish citizens can stay up to 90 days. The Immigration Department says a short visit visa is issued for a period of 90 days.

faq.question: Do I need a yellow fever vaccine for The Gambia?
faq.answer: WHO lists The Gambia as requiring a yellow fever certificate from travellers aged 9 months and over arriving from a country with risk of yellow fever transmission, a list that includes neighbouring Senegal. Australia's travel advice goes further and says you need a valid yellow fever certificate to enter The Gambia.

faq.question: When is the best time to visit The Gambia?
faq.answer: No official source names a best time to visit. The UK FCDO and the Government of Canada say the rainy season runs from June to October, when flooding can disrupt roads.
